#include <iostream>
#include <vector>

using namespace std;

struct IntList {
    vector<int> data;
    int size;

    IntList() : data(3), size(0) {}

    bool empty() const {
        return size == 0;
    }

    int length() const {
        return size;
    }

    int get(int index) const {
        if (index < 0 || index >= size) throw out_of_range("Index out of bounds");
        return data[index];
    }

    void reset() {
        size = 0;
    }

    void assign(int index, int value) {
        if (index < 0 || index >= size) throw out_of_range("Index out of bounds");
        data[index] = value;
    }

    void resize() {
        if (size >= (int)data.size()) {
            data.resize((data.size() << 1) + 1);
        }
    }

    void insertAt(int index, int value) {
        if (index < 0 || index > size) throw out_of_range("Index out of bounds");
        resize();
        data.insert(data.begin() + index, value);
        size++;
    }

    int removeAt(int index) {
        if (index < 0 || index >= size) throw out_of_range("Index out of bounds");
        int val = data[index];
        data.erase(data.begin() + index);
        size--;
        return val;
    }

    void add(int value) {
        resize();
        if (size >= (int)data.size()) {
            data.resize((data.size() << 1) + 1);
        }
        data[size++] = value;
    }

    int removeLast() {
        if (size == 0) throw runtime_error("No element");
        return data[--size];
    }

    void addFirst(int value) {
        resize();
        data.insert(data.begin(), value);
        size++;
    }

    int removeFirst() {
        if (size == 0) throw runtime_error("No element");
        int val = data[0];
        data.erase(data.begin());
        size--;
        return val;
    }
};

struct IntIntMap {
    static const int EMPTY = INT_MIN;
    vector<int> data;
    int size;

    IntIntMap() : data(4, EMPTY), size(0) {}

    bool isEmpty() const {
        return size == 0;
    }

    int getSize() const {
        return size;
    }

    void clear() {
        for (int i = 0; i < (int)data.size(); i += 2) {
            data[i] = EMPTY;
        }
        size = 0;
    }

    static int hash(int key) {
        int h = key * 1000000007;
        h ^= (h >> 16);
        h ^= (h >> 24);
        return h;
    }

    bool containsKey(int key) {
        if (key == EMPTY) throw invalid_argument("Invalid key");
        int mask = (int)data.size() - 2;
        for (int i = hash(key) & mask;; i = (i - 1) & mask) {
            int cur = data[i];
            if (cur == key) return true;
            if (cur == EMPTY) return false;
        }
    }

    int get(int key, int defaultVal) {
        if (key == EMPTY) throw invalid_argument("Invalid key");
        int mask = (int)data.size() - 2;
        for (int i = hash(key) & mask;; i = (i - 1) & mask) {
            int cur = data[i];
            if (cur == key) return data[i + 1];
            if (cur == EMPTY) return defaultVal;
        }
    }

    static vector<int> resize(const vector<int>& oldData, int newCap) {
        vector<int> newData(newCap, EMPTY);
        for (int i = 0; i < newCap; i += 2) {
            newData[i] = EMPTY;
        }
        int mask = newCap - 2;
        for (size_t i = 0; i + 1 < oldData.size(); i += 2) {
            int cur = oldData[i];
            if (cur == EMPTY) continue;
            for (int j = hash(cur) & mask;; j = (j - 1) & mask) {
                if (newData[j] == EMPTY) {
                    newData[j] = cur;
                    newData[j + 1] = oldData[i + 1];
                    break;
                }
            }
        }
        return newData;
    }

    void put(int key, int value) {
        if (key == EMPTY) throw invalid_argument("Invalid key");
        vector<int>& d = data;
        int cap = (int)d.size();
        int mask = cap - 2;
        for (int i = hash(key) & mask;; i = (i - 1) & mask) {
            int cur = d[i];
            if (cur == key) {
                d[i + 1] = value;
                return;
            } else if (cur == EMPTY) {
                d[i] = key;
                d[i + 1] = value;
                if (++size > (cap >> 2)) {
                    d = resize(d, cap << 1);
                    data = d;
                }
                return;
            }
        }
    }

    void remove(int key) {
        if (key == EMPTY) throw invalid_argument("Invalid key");
        vector<int>& d = data;
        int cap = (int)d.size();
        int mask = cap - 2;
        for (int i = hash(key) & mask;; i = (i - 1) & mask) {
            int cur = d[i];
            if (cur == key) {
                for (int j = i;;) {
                    int nextIdx = (j - 1) & mask;
                    int k = d[nextIdx];
                    if (k == EMPTY) {
                        d[i] = EMPTY;
                        --size;
                        return;
                    }
                    int kHash = hash(k) & mask;
                    if (((kHash >= i) ^ (kHash < nextIdx) ^ (i < nextIdx))) {
                        d[i] = k;
                        d[i + 1] = d[nextIdx + 1];
                        i = nextIdx;
                    } else {
                        break;
                    }
                }
            } else if (cur == EMPTY) {
                return;
            }
        }
    }
};

vector<IntList> freeLists;

IntList getList() {
    if (freeLists.empty()) {
        return IntList();
    } else {
        IntList lst = freeLists.back();
        freeLists.pop_back();
        return lst;
    }
}

void releaseList(IntList& list) {
    list.reset();
    freeLists.push_back(list);
}

int n, m;

IntList processRange(int start, int end) {
    IntList res;
    if (start + 1 == end) {
        res = getList();
        res.add(start);
        if (start + m > n) {
            res.add(n - start);
            res.add(start - n);
        }
        res.add(m);
        if (start > m) {
            res.add(n - start);
            res.add(start);
        }
        res.add(-start);
    } else {
        int mid = (start + end) >> 1;
        IntList leftPart = processRange(start, mid);
        IntList rightPart = processRange(mid, end);
        res = getList();
        int leftSz = leftPart.size;
        int rightSz = rightPart.size;
        vector<int>& leftData = leftPart.data;
        vector<int>& rightData = rightPart.data;
        for (int i = 0;; i += 2) {
            int bFrom = (i == 0) ? 0 : rightData[i - 1];
            int bTo = (i == rightSz - 1) ? n : rightData[i + 1];
            int bShift = rightData[i];
            int aFrom = bFrom + bShift;
            int aTo = bTo + bShift;
            int lIdx = 0, rIdx = leftSz - 1;
            while (lIdx < rIdx) {
                int mIdx = (((lIdx + rIdx) >> 2) << 1) + 1;
                if (leftData[mIdx] <= aFrom) {
                    lIdx = mIdx + 1;
                } else {
                    rIdx = mIdx - 1;
                }
            }
            int curIdx = lIdx;
            while (true) {
                res.add(bShift + leftData[curIdx]);
                ++curIdx;
                if (curIdx == leftSz) break;
                int pos = leftData[curIdx];
                if (pos >= aTo) break;
                res.add(pos - bShift);
                ++curIdx;
            }
            if (i == rightSz - 1) break;
            res.add(bTo);
        }
        releaseList(leftPart);
        releaseList(rightPart);
    }
    return res;
}

int main() {
    ios::sync_with_stdio(false);
    cin.tie(nullptr);
    int s;
    long long t;
    cin >> n >> m;
    cin >> s;
    cin >> t;
    s -= 1;
    long long t_mod = t % n;
    for (long long ct = t_mod; ct != 0; ct--) {
        if (s < m) {
            s += 1;
            if (s >= n) s -= n;
        } else {
            s -= 1;
            if (s < 0) s += n;
        }
    }
    long long cycles = t / n;
    if (cycles > 0) {
        IntList cycleSeq = processRange(0, n);
        int sizeSeq = cycleSeq.size;
        vector<int>& dataSeq = cycleSeq.data;
        IntList cycleList = getList();
        IntIntMap cycleMap;
        for (int i = 0; i < cycles; i++) {
            int prevIdx = cycleMap.get(s, -1);
            if (prevIdx >= 0) {
                s = cycleList.get(prevIdx + (int)((cycles - prevIdx) % (i - prevIdx)));
                break;
            }
            cycleList.add(s);
            cycleMap.put(s, i);
            int lIdx = 0, rIdx = sizeSeq - 1;
            while (lIdx < rIdx) {
                int mIdx = (((lIdx + rIdx) >> 2) << 1) + 1;
                if (dataSeq[mIdx] <= s) {
                    lIdx = mIdx + 1;
                } else {
                    rIdx = mIdx - 1;
                }
            }
            s += dataSeq[lIdx];
        }
        releaseList(cycleSeq);
        releaseList(cycleList);
    }
    cout << s + 1;
    return 0;
}
